Hello Sarah — I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. My free slots are:

- Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30

Which of these works for you? If none does, tell me what you have free and I'll see what I can move.
Checking my week against those slots — one moment.

Hi Professor — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 works for me. I've put the CSE455 staff meeting in then; it sits right before my CSE455 office hours, so it's a good fit.

Monday 10:00 and 14:00 are out (Focus: CSE452 lab; Study group + Seminar), as are Tuesday 11:00 (Seminar) and Wednesday 10:00 (CSE455 office hours) and 13:00 (Lunch). So no need to move anything: Tuesday 15:00 it is. It's booked once it's on your calendar too.
Confirmed — Tuesday 15:00-15:30, CSE455 staff meeting. It's on my calendar now too, so it's booked. Thanks, Sarah.
